brief.text: Closed-End Funds represent a frequent industry pattern across cluster buys, accounting for four separate entries in BPRE, NXG, CRAFX, and SWZ totaling over $41.3 million. BORR posted the largest overall figure on the dashboard at $57,144,458 across three insiders, while GPI logged the single largest individual filing at $24,232,209 from 10% owner Conifer Management, L.L.C. FUL stood out for participant breadth, leading all issuers with eight separate insiders filing purchases totaling $1,123,318.
